release_notes: Build 91 adds a Diagnostics tab to Quiz Archive Audit so archive relinking and database persistence can be checked without changing any files.
Ambiguous archive folders now show the exact competing Quiz History IDs, scores, current paths, and any competing Z: folders for the suggested History record.
Diagnostics shows the primary SQLite database path, runtime/data roots, database size and modified time, plus any alternate factvault.db candidates visible to the app.
Stored Z: paths and currently existing Z: paths are reported separately so a database rollback can be distinguished from a temporarily unavailable archive path or drive.

From Build 91 onward, successful Relink selected operations are also journaled outside SQLite; future diagnostics explicitly flag a History ID if its stored path later differs from the confirmed relink or if the app is using a different database path.
The Diagnostics tab includes Refresh diagnostics and Copy diagnostics; diagnostics are read-only and relinking still changes Quiz History database paths only.
Build 90 made Match archive faster with cached folder fingerprints and stronger same-folder/same-file copy identity matching.
Build 89 keeps Quiz Archive Audit open and refreshes it in place after each selected relink.
No archive diagnostic or relink action copies, moves, renames, overwrites, or deletes existing Z: files.
